title: VUA inspection.requestRun (v0.1)
description: Write-command face of the M7 inspection slice (proposal 016, hard precondition 2): the tasked command that drives the five Bridge producing operations (v1 validate_avatar and analyze_performance typed checks, v3 read-only inspection operations inspect_avatar_references / inspect_lighting / inspect_upload_readiness) and publishes exactly one inspection-evidence document per run under a fresh AMF-generated uuid-v7 inspectionId. DRAFT (core implementation batch 2026-09-13, same inspection-queries family as the data-role get/list row; NOT frozen, not registered: the freeze lands with the implementation batch acceptance). The acceptance reply follows the tasked-command face (job.execute precedent): the caller polls the application task face by taskId; the task result payload carries the inspectionId and the aggregated overallStatus. avatarRef is the verbatim identity of the inspected avatar (namespaced identity or explicit scene path, never a guess); avatarGlobalObjectId is the Unity scene target the producing operations inspect. Params are a closed two-key set; paths are provider-bound configuration and never travel the wire (M3/T1 ruling).

avatarGlobalObjectId.description: The Unity scene object identity the inspection operations target (payload of every producing command, closed single payload shape per the 016 operation-shape proposal).

avatarRef.description: Verbatim identity of the inspected avatar, carried into the evidence body unchanged (ref required; label is the observed display name when one exists, never invented).

inspection-requestRunResult.description: Tasked-command acceptance (job.execute reply shape): poll the application task face by taskId; do not poll this method again.
